title: Job (the method card)
description: One job the owner wants done, in two halves. Part A, the job: stable, tool-free — the job story, who told it, the owner, the desired outcomes and what must not go wrong. Part B, the method: current — the job map, its steps and tasks, who is hired for each, the rules, inputs and questions. Organise phase (with Capture and Distil feeding it).

name.description: A verb and an object: 'Create a Revit family', 'Create GAs'.

owner.description: The person responsible for this job in the owning organisation.

jobStory.description: Part A. When [situation], I want to [motivation], so I can [outcome]. In the teller's words.

toldBy.description: Part A. Everyone whose account shaped this job. Aim for the doer and the checker at least.

sources.description: Sources this job was built from.

outcomes.description: Part A. 3–7 measurable, tool-free outcome statements: 'Reduce the chance that …', 'Reduce the time it takes to …'. The yardstick the review measures against.

measure.description: How it is measured, if known.

mustNotGoWrong.description: Part A. What would embarrass the owner, cost money or be unsafe. Steps touching these keep a person's final yes.

jobMap.description: Part B. The job's steps placed on the eight universal job stages. A stage with no step is a gap and should carry a question.

gap.description: Set when no step covers this stage: what is missing.

inputs.description: Part B. Sources, packs, libraries and tools the job needs.

openQuestions.description: Part B. Questions (Q-) still open for this job.

review.description: Part B. How runs of this job are reviewed.

deep.description: When a deep review (debrief) is held.

does.description: What the step achieves, in plain words.

hired.description: Who does the step today, and who could.

finalYes.description: true when a person must give the final yes on this step's result.

tool.description: A registered tool/script (TOOL-) that does it, if any.

workRecord.description: What every run of this step must leave behind.
